body: a forest-tech canopy transit pod, a small enclosed capsule shape suspended from a single overhead zipline wheel-clamp, full clean side-profile reference view, a simple round viewing window and a single door (empty, no rider), built to glide along canopy-line cables between treetops. Deep pine #1f3d2e shell almost entirely overtaken by real moss and small ferns growing directly out of the panel seams (matching the forest ape mount's reclaimed-machine look), aged copper #6b7a5c fittings and the overhead clamp wheel patinated green, thin glow-moss emerald #00ff9c veins running under the moss. TURTLE'S NOTE: this should look like it's been hanging in the canopy for years, genuinely reclaimed by the forest, not designed to look mossy -- asymmetric coverage, thicker on top where rain collects. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, dappled canopy-filtered forest light, plain flat neutral-green background so the silhouette reads clearly, full pod visible including the overhead clamp wheel, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
